change_summary: Probation leave changed from none to 5 casual days; working hours extended from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM.
Annual leave notice increased from 7 to 14 days; mandatory leave increased from 3 to 5 consecutive days.
Minimum password length increased from 8 to 12; password change cycle reduced from 90 to 60 days.
Retention period increased from 7 to 10 years; breach reporting reduced from 24 hours to 2 hours.
AML training deadline reduced from 30 to 14 days; large-cash approval threshold reduced from PKR 2.5M to PKR 2M.
Complaint escalation reduced from 48 to 24 hours; outage escalation reduced from 30 to 15 minutes.
Paper signature replaced by digital photo and signature capture; approval time reduced from 2 days to 1 day.
Teller drawer limit reduced from PKR 2M to PKR 1.5M; vault reconciliation changed from weekly to daily.
P1 acknowledgement reduced from 30 to 15 minutes; access fulfilment reduced from 5 to 3 working days.
Pass mark increased from 60% to 70%; AML deadline changed from 45 to 30 days.
